	Manage inventory receipt, verification, and documentation of all incoming materials

	Manage returns, repairs, and faulty equipment reporting

	Minimum of 3 years of experience in inventory management or a related role
	Professional certification in Supply Chain/Inventory Management is an added advantage

	Knowledge of ERP systems or accounting software (e.g., PARIC, Sun System)
	Strong documentation and record-keeping skills
	Previous experience working in a real estate company
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools
	Excellent communication skills
	Presentable and smart.
	Previous experience working as an Inventory officer in a Real estate company is a must and Applicants must be resident on the Island.


Salary
N300,000 per month.&nbsp;

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV to: hr@prive.living using &quot;Inventory Officer - Male&quot; as the subject of the email.",

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)",
  "description": "RecruitwithAdenike is a&nbsp;recruitment and talent solutions brand committed to connecting high-performing professionals with forward-thinking organizations across diverse industries. From entry-level roles to executive placements, we help businesses attract, engage, and retain the right talent to fuel growth and success. Our approach is efficient, personalized, and rooted in a deep understanding of people and business needs.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and people-focused HR Business Partner (HRBP) to join our Microfinance Bank and provide strategic and operational HR support across a large workforce.
	The HRBP will partner closely with business leaders and managers to align people strategies with business objectives, drive employee engagement and performance, manage employee relations, support workforce planning, and ensure effective implementation of HR policies and processes.
	The ideal candidate must be comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced financial services environment, managing multiple stakeholders and employee-related matters while maintaining confidentiality, professionalism, and strong business judgment.


Key Responsibilities


	Partner with business leaders and line managers to understand workforce needs and provide practical HR solutions.
	Manage HR support for a workforce of 1,000+ employees across different functions and business units.
	Provide guidance to managers on employee relations, performance management, disciplinary matters, grievances, and workplace issues.
	Drive the implementation of HR policies, procedures, and initiatives across the business.
	Support workforce planning, manpower budgeting, organizational restructuring, and succession planning.
	Monitor employee performance and work with managers to address performance gaps and improve productivity.
	Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives across the organization.
	Support talent management, career development, and succession planning initiatives.
	Partner with Recruitment and business leaders on manpower requirements and workforce expansion.
	Analyze HR data and workforce trends to provide insights and recommendations to management.
	Support employee onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and other employee lifecycle processes.
	Ensure effective communication of HR policies, processes, and organizational changes to employees.
	Identify recurring people-related issues and recommend solutions that improve employee experience and business performance.
	Work closely with Payroll, Recruitment, Learning &amp; Development, and other HR teams to ensure seamless HR service delivery.
	Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, regulatory requirements, and internal HR policies.
	Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HR documentation.
	Prepare and present HR reports, workforce analytics, and people-related insights to senior management.
	Handle other HR-related responsibilities as assigned by the Head of HR/HR Director.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Psychology, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience as an HR Business Partner or in a generalist HR role.
	Experience managing HR support for more than1,000+ employees.
	Previous experience in Microfinance Banking, Commercial Banking, Fintech, Financial Services, Consulting or another highly regulated and high-volume environment is strongly preferred.
	Strong knowledge of employee relations, performance management, HR policies, workforce planning, and employment practices.
	Demonstrated experience partnering with senior managers and business leaders.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian labour laws and HR compliance requirements.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret HR data and provide actionable recommendations.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
	Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and HRIS platforms.
	Professional HR certification such as CIPM, SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent is an added advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Strategic HR Business Partnering
	Employee Relations
	Workforce Planning
	Performance Management
	Talent Management
	Employee Engagement
	Conflict Resolution
	HR Analytics
	Stakeholder Management
	Labour Law &amp; HR Compliance
	Change Management
	Leadership and Influencing Skills
	Problem Solving
	Confidentiality and Professionalism


Ideal Candidate Profile:


	The ideal candidate is a hands-on HR professional who has managed HR activities at scale, understands the dynamics of a large workforce, and can confidently work with both employees and senior management.
	The person should be commercially minded, proactive, data-driven, and capable of balancing employee advocacy with business objectives.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to recruitmentforce.africa@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

title: Job Openings at Recruit with Adenike
content:
Recruit with Adenike is a recruitment and talent solutions brand committed to connecting high-performing professionals with forward-thinking organizations across diverse industries. From entry-level roles to executive placements, we help businesses attract, engage, and retain the right talent to fuel growth and success. Our approach is efficient, personalized, and rooted in a deep understanding of people and business needs.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Credit Risk Officer

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Financial Institution

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Credit Risk Officer to assess borrowers' creditworthiness, monitor loan portfolio performance, and support effective credit risk management.
	The ideal candidate must have a background in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field, with foundational knowledge of credit risk and lending processes.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct credit assessments and analyze financial statements, cash flows, and audit reports to determine borrowers' creditworthiness.
	Conduct due diligence visits to verify business operations, financial information, and repayment capacity.
	Prepare credit approval memoranda outlining financial analysis, identified risks, and lending recommendations.
	Develop and implement credit policies, risk assessment criteria, and lending decision rules.
	Monitor loan portfolio performance, identify potential defaults, and recommend risk mitigation measures.
	Collaborate with Product, Decision Science, and other teams to improve credit scoring models and lending decisions.
	Identify potential fraud and operational risks and recommend appropriate controls.
	Ensure compliance with applicable CBN guidelines, AML/CFT requirements, data protection regulations, and internal credit policies.
	Prepare credit risk reports and recommend strategies to improve portfolio quality.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Banking and Finance, or a related field.
	Minimum of 1 year of experience in consumer credit, credit risk analysis, credit assessment, or credit portfolio management.
	Good knowledge of financial statement analysis, credit assessment, and lending processes.
	Ability to analyze audit reports, conduct due diligence visits, and prepare credit approval memoranda.
	Basic understanding of credit risk management and regulatory requirements.
	Strong analytical, numerical, communication, and report-writing skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis tools.
	Ability to balance business growth with effective risk management.


Non-Negotiable Requirements:


	Financial statement analysis and audit report review.
	Physical due diligence visits.
	Preparation of credit approval memoranda.


Application Closing Date: 31st December, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Customer Support Specialist (Igbo Speaking)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking an Igbo Language Specialist to support the translation and localization of content for a fintech/digital financial services app.
	The successful candidate will help make financial products and services more accessible and easier to understand for Igbo-speaking users.


Key Responsibilities


	Translate fintech and app content from English into Igbo.
	Produce clear, accurate, and natural Igbo translations.
	Proofread content for grammar, spelling, clarity, and consistency.
	Adapt financial and fintech terminology for easy understanding.
	Provide simple English back-translations when required.
	Maintain consistent terminology across the app.
	Review and revise translations based on feedback.
	Support user interviews, usability testing, and research involving Igbo-speaking users.
	Interpret research conversations and accurately communicate user feedback.


Requirements


	Degree or formal academic training in Igbo, Nigerian Languages, Linguistics, or a related discipline with 2-5 years of experience.
	Strong reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills in Igbo.
	Good written and spoken English.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Ability to write clearly and formally in Igbo.
	Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.
	Interest in fintech, digital products, or financial services is an added advantage.
	Willingness to learn and receive feedback.


Application Closing Date: 31st December, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

3.) Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and people-focused HR Business Partner (HRBP) to join our Microfinance Bank and provide strategic and operational HR support across a large workforce.
	The HRBP will partner closely with business leaders and managers to align people strategies with business objectives, drive employee engagement and performance, manage employee relations, support workforce planning, and ensure effective implementation of HR policies and processes.
	The ideal candidate must be comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced financial services environment, managing multiple stakeholders and employee-related matters while maintaining confidentiality, professionalism, and strong business judgment.


Key Responsibilities


	Partner with business leaders and line managers to understand workforce needs and provide practical HR solutions.
	Manage HR support for a workforce of 1,000+ employees across different functions and business units.
	Provide guidance to managers on employee relations, performance management, disciplinary matters, grievances, and workplace issues.
	Drive the implementation of HR policies, procedures, and initiatives across the business.
	Support workforce planning, manpower budgeting, organizational restructuring, and succession planning.
	Monitor employee performance and work with managers to address performance gaps and improve productivity.
	Drive employee engagement and retention initiatives across the organization.
	Support talent management, career development, and succession planning initiatives.
	Partner with Recruitment and business leaders on manpower requirements and workforce expansion.
	Analyze HR data and workforce trends to provide insights and recommendations to management.
	Support employee onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and other employee lifecycle processes.
	Ensure effective communication of HR policies, processes, and organizational changes to employees.
	Identify recurring people-related issues and recommend solutions that improve employee experience and business performance.
	Work closely with Payroll, Recruitment, Learning & Development, and other HR teams to ensure seamless HR service delivery.
	Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, regulatory requirements, and internal HR policies.
	Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HR documentation.
	Prepare and present HR reports, workforce analytics, and people-related insights to senior management.
	Handle other HR-related responsibilities as assigned by the Head of HR/HR Director.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Psychology, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience as an HR Business Partner or in a generalist HR role.
	Experience managing HR support for more than1,000+ employees.
	Previous experience in Microfinance Banking, Commercial Banking, Fintech, Financial Services, Consulting or another highly regulated and high-volume environment is strongly preferred.
	Strong knowledge of employee relations, performance management, HR policies, workforce planning, and employment practices.
	Demonstrated experience partnering with senior managers and business leaders.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian labour laws and HR compliance requirements.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret HR data and provide actionable recommendations.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
	Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and HRIS platforms.
	Professional HR certification such as CIPM, SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent is an added advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Strategic HR Business Partnering
	Employee Relations
	Workforce Planning
	Performance Management
	Talent Management
	Employee Engagement
	Conflict Resolution
	HR Analytics
	Stakeholder Management
	Labour Law & HR Compliance
	Change Management
	Leadership and Influencing Skills
	Problem Solving
	Confidentiality and Professionalism


Ideal Candidate Profile:


	The ideal candidate is a hands-on HR professional who has managed HR activities at scale, understands the dynamics of a large workforce, and can confidently work with both employees and senior management.
	The person should be commercially minded, proactive, data-driven, and capable of balancing employee advocacy with business objectives.


Application Closing Date: 31st October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
